SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.W.S.W.B. REGISTRY.
No. D 2554/43.
Date 7 / 2 / 34）

REPORT
S.2, Special Branch
Date February 8, 1934.

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda obtained in Western Chapei.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by D.J. Sweeney.

I submit hereunder brief particulars of four communist
handbills which were obtained by Agents A-2523 and A-3442 in
Western Chapei on February 7, 1934 :-

(1) Handbill entitled "Shanghai Workers' Newspaper," Issue No.
33, dated January 25, 1934, issued by the Federation of
Shanghai Labour Unions (Old Labour Union). It contains
a leading article bearing on the Second Anniversary of the
Commencement of Sino-Japanese Hostilities in Shanghai on
January 28, 1932.

(2) Handbill entitled "Letter to Shanghai Labour Friends in
support of the struggle started by Kailan Miners," issued
by the Propaganda Department of the Federation of Shanghai
Labour Unions (Old Labour Union) and dated January 30,
urging the workers in Shanghai to organize committees in
support of the Kailan Strikers, to raise subscriptions to
aid them, to demand the punishment by workers of culprits
who killed the miners, and to demand issue of compassionate
grants to families of killed and wounded miners.

(3) Leaflet entitled "Letter to workers of the Nagai Wata Cotton
Mills opposing the dismissal and assault of workers by
capitalists," issued by the General Labour Union of Shanghai
Cotton Mills and dated February 6.
"Appoint representatives to demand that the capitalists
accept your conditions!"
"Declare a strike and fight for the establishment of the
Shanghai General Labour Union!"

(4) Leaflet entitled "Letter to popular masses in connection
with the Fukien People's Government," issued by the Propaganda
Department of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Chinese
